title: Copro Lights
content: I'm pleased to announce our newest Dinotopia themed collection of Copro Lights®.Working with leading paleontologists and the finest home designers, we have created an extensive selection of lighting accessories that feature accurate resin replicas of fossilized dinosaur droppings.Pictured here is theUltrasaurus Luxtable lamp, which comes with Clap-Crap® technology for remote on-off switching. Just clap once to switch on and twice to switch off. Great for the disabled, elderly, or just plain lazy. Now you can always find the light!And don't miss our selection ofDinotopia-themed casketsfor that special relative who wants to spend their afterlife in "the land apart from time."More on Dinotopia Copro LightsRelated post:the new Mac iBoxBy the way, April Fools!
